# The Bellringer - import codes

Copy a code (GitHub shows a **Copy** button at the top right of each box), then in a JJS private server open your **Character Block -> Configure** (the Skill Builder) and paste it into **Import**. Each code is one line starting with `KLUv/`; paste all of it.
